header.title: LG Refrigerator Evaporator Fan Replacement
header.description: Use this guide to replace the evaporator fan on...

steps.description:
- Unplug your refrigerator before you begin your repair.
- If you are testing or repairing the following items, you may also need to shut off and disconnect the water supply:
- Condenser fan motor
- Compressor motor and thermal overload device
- Water supply valve assembly
actions: ['Unplug your refrigerator.']
['Shut off and disconnect the water supply for the condenser fan motor.']
['Shut off and disconnect the water supply for the compressor motor.']
['Shut off and disconnect the water supply for the thermal overload device.']
['Shut off and disconnect the water supply for the water supply valve assembly.']

steps.description: - Pull open the freezer door fully.
actions: ['Pull open the freezer door fully.']

steps.description:
- Lift and remove the upper pull-out drawer.
- Lift and remove the main drawer bin.
actions: ['Lift and remove the upper pull-out drawer.']
['Lift and remove the main drawer bin.']

steps.description:
- Use your finger or a flat-blade screwdriver to depress the two locking tabs on the right drawer rail cover.
- Lift the cover off of the rail and remove it.
- Repeat this procedure for the left drawer rail cover.
actions: ['Use your finger or a flat-blade screwdriver to depress the two locking tabs on the right drawer rail cover.']
['Lift the cover off of the rail and remove it.']
['Repeat this procedure for the left drawer rail cover.']

steps.description:
- The drawer rail covers can be tricky to reinstall. Follow these steps to reinstall them:
- Hold the drawer rail cover flush against the side of the drawer rail.
- You should feel the locking tabs protruding.
- Push the rail cover straight downward to install. It should click into place.
actions: ['Hold the drawer rail cover flush against the side of the drawer rail.']
['Push the rail cover straight downward to install.']

steps.description: - Use a Phillips screwdriver to remove the screw securing the drawer to each of the drawer slides.
actions: ['Use a Phillips screwdriver to remove the screw securing the drawer to each of the drawer slides.']

steps.description:
- Lift the front of the drawer up.
- Pull the drawer toward you to release the drawer from the drawer slides.
- Remove the freezer drawer.
actions: ['Lift the front of the drawer up.']
['Pull the drawer toward you to release the drawer from the drawer slides.']
['Remove the freezer drawer.']

steps.description: - Use a Phillips screwdriver to remove the screws securing both left drawer slides.
actions: ['Use a Phillips screwdriver to remove the screws securing both left drawer slides.']

steps.description:
- Pull the upper left drawer slide slightly towards you to release the locking tab at the rear.
- Remove the upper left drawer slide.
actions: ['Pull the upper left drawer slide slightly towards you to release the locking tab at the rear.']
['Remove the upper left drawer slide.']

steps.description:
- Pull the lower left drawer slide slightly toward you to release the locking tab at the rear.
- Reposition the lower left drawer slide to gain access to the door switch connector.
actions: ['Pull the lower left drawer slide slightly toward you to release the locking tab at the rear.']
['Reposition the lower left drawer slide to gain access to the door switch connector.']

steps.description:
- Squeeze the door switch connector to release it.
- Pull the door switch connector down to disconnect it.
- Remove the lower left drawer slide.
- If you are removing the freezer evaporator cover, likely only the left-hand slides may need to be removed. In some cases you will need to repeat the previous three steps to remove the right slides as well.
actions: ['Squeeze the door switch connector to release it.']
['Pull the door switch connector down to disconnect it.']
['Remove the lower left drawer slide.']
['Repeat the previous three steps to remove the right slides if necessary.']

steps.description: - Use a Phillips screwdriver to remove the screws securing the ice maker to the top of the freezer compartment.
actions: ['Use a Phillips screwdriver to remove the screws securing the ice maker to the top of the freezer compartment.']

steps.description:
- Insert a flat-blade screwdriver into the slot located on the right edge of the ice maker.
- Pry outward with the screwdriver to release the locking tab securing the ice maker to the fridge.
- When the tab releases, pull the right front corner of the ice maker down.
actions: ['Insert a flat-blade screwdriver into the slot located on the right edge of the ice maker.']
['Pry outward with the screwdriver to release the locking tab securing the ice maker to the fridge.']
['Pull the right front corner of the ice maker down.']

steps.description: - Repeat the previous operation on the left side of the ice maker to release it.
actions: ['Repeat the previous operation on the left side of the ice maker to release it.']

steps.description:
- Grasp the front edge of the ice maker and pull it towards you.
- Lower the ice maker.
actions: ['Grasp the front edge of the ice maker and pull it towards you.']
['Lower the ice maker.']

steps.description:
- Squeeze the ice maker connector to release it and pull it straight out to disconnect it.
- Remove the ice maker.
actions: ['Squeeze the ice maker connector to release it.']
['Pull it straight out to disconnect it.']
['Remove the ice maker.']

steps.description:
- Pinch the rear portion of the air return cover to release it from the freezer wall.
- Pull the air return cover outward and remove it.
actions: ['Pinch the rear portion of the air return cover to release it from the freezer wall.']
['Pull the air return cover outward and remove it.']

steps.description: - Use a Philips screwdriver to remove the screw (or screws) securing the evaporator cover.
actions: ['Use a Phillips screwdriver to remove the screw (or screws) securing the evaporator cover.']

steps.description:
- Don't try to remove the evaporator cover fully, as It is still connected to the fridge with a number of wires.
- Grasp the evaporator cover by the air vent openings and pull the top edge toward you.
actions: ['Grasp the evaporator cover by the air vent openings.']
['Pull the top edge toward you.']

steps.description:
- Lift the evaporator cover slightly to release the tabs at the lower edge.
- Swing the left edge of the evaporator cover toward you and lower it.
actions: ['Lift the evaporator cover slightly to release the tabs at the lower edge.']
['Swing the left edge of the evaporator cover toward you and lower it.']

steps.description:
- Disconnect the electrical connections in the upper left corner of the freezer.
- Make a note of the locations of the connections for re-installation.
actions: ['Disconnect the electrical connections in the upper left corner of the freezer.']

steps.description:
- Swing the left edge of the evaporator cover further toward you to access the connections in the upper right corner.
- Squeeze and pull the connector to disconnect the thermistor mounted in the evaporator cover.
actions: ['Swing the left edge of the evaporator cover further toward you.']
['Squeeze and pull the connector to disconnect the thermistor mounted in the evaporator cover.']

steps.description: - Remove the evaporator cover.
actions: ['Remove the evaporator cover.']

steps.description:
- Use a Philips screwdriver to remove the screws securing the evaporator fan assembly to the evaporator cover.
- Remove the evaporator fan assembly.
actions: ['Use a Phillips screwdriver to remove the screws securing the evaporator fan assembly to the evaporator cover.']
['Remove the evaporator fan assembly.']

steps.description:
- Insert two flat-head screwdrivers through the top of the fan opening in the fan assembly.
- Position the head of each screwdriver opposite each other underneath the fan hub.
- Use the screwdrivers to pry the fan off the shaft.
- Remove the fan.
actions: ['Insert two flat-head screwdrivers through the top of the fan opening in the fan assembly.']
['Position the head of each screwdriver opposite each other underneath the fan hub.']
['Use the screwdrivers to pry the fan off the shaft.']
['Remove the fan.']

steps.description:
- Cut any cable ties securing the motor wires to the evaporator fan assembly.
- Unhook the motor wires from the evaporator fan assembly.
actions: ['Cut any cable ties securing the motor wires to the evaporator fan assembly.']
['Unhook the motor wires from the evaporator fan assembly.']

steps.description:
- Use a Phillips screwdriver to remove the screws securing the evaporator fan motor cover.
- Remove the evaporator fan motor from the evaporator fan assembly.
- Your [link|https://guide-images.cdn.ifixit.com/igi/2aqeQNUsBpYDtREq.full|replacement motor|new_window=true] may not come with [link|https://guide-images.cdn.ifixit.com/igi/I1qNvXQsgNZ151O4.full|the two rubber motor mounts|new_window=true]. Transfer them from the old motor and motor cover.
actions: ['Use a Phillips screwdriver to remove the screws securing the evaporator fan motor cover.']
['Remove the evaporator fan motor from the evaporator fan assembly.']
['Transfer the two rubber motor mounts from the old motor and motor cover if necessary.']
